sentences.text:
Shri A.K. Sethi - Senior Advocate with Shri Rishiraj Tr
 for appellant.
Shri Mukesh Sharma - G.A for respondent/State.
Heard on admission.
Appeal is admitted for final hearing.

Also heard On I.A No. 16878/2022 which is an application filed under Section 389 of Cr.P.C, for suspension of jail sentence moved on behalf of the appellant Devisingh.
The appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
Fine if Imprisonment Section Act Imprisonment Deposited, in lieu of fine details 420/120B IPC 5 years R.I 1000/- 6 months R.I 467/120B IPC 7 years R.I 1000/- 6 months R.I 468/120B IPC 5 years R.I 1000/- 6 months R.I 471/120B IPC 1 year R.I 500/- 2 months R.I 472/120B IPC 2 years R.I 500/- 2 months R.I

As per prosecution case, the Branch Manager of the Bank of India, Thikri lodged a complaint to the Superintendent of Police on 26/12/2014, to the effect that on 9.11.2011 the co-accused Surajbai and Prahlad had obtained a loan from the Bank of Rs.
9,00,000/- by submitting forged revenue papers.
The allegation against the present appellant is that, he was an Advocate and submitted his wrong search report on the basis of which the loan was granted.
He has been made accused with the aid of Section 120 (B) of IPC.
Counsel for appellant submits that the appellant was on bail during the trial and he did not misuse the liberty granted to him.
The final hearing of the appeal is likely to take time.
Hence, his remaining custodial period be suspended.

sentences.text: Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the allegation against the present appellant is that he had submitted a wrong search report and and also the fact that he was on bail during the trial and he did not misuse the liberty granted to him, this Court is of the view that it is a fit case for suspension of the sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Hence, without expressing any opinion on merits of the matter I.A.No.16878/2022 is allowed and jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited the appellant shall be released on bail, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) alongwith a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 5.7.2023 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
With the aforesaid, the I.A is allowed and disposed off.
C.C today.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE VM Devi Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11806826/
